canonicalVocabulary.townOfficialName: Golmohar Junction Municipal Transitional Development Area
canonicalVocabulary.realPlaceExclusion: Golmohar Junction is fictional. It is not the real Golmohar Railway Quarters in Howrah, is not a disguised ward, and must not be placed at a real coordinate.

fixedFacts: Album 001 contains exactly 62 numbered story pages; cover, title material, credits and end matter are additional.
Reading direction is left-to-right and the web edition is primarily a vertical long-form reader.
The Grid is an interlocking administrative system, not one magical all-purpose computer.
Golmohar's distance from Calcutta and administrative status are deliberately disputed by incompatible records.
Unit C-17, called Cecil, is a non-human municipal compliance unit and must never be depicted as a child, mascot or magically emotional robot.
Director Vale is sincere, observant and capable; their error is confidence in a model's jurisdiction, not secret malice.
The town's human practices preserve knowledge and mutual aid but also produce delay, favouritism, exclusion, exhaustion and inconsistent records.
The Grid creates real gains as well as harmful misclassification.
Album 001 ends with a hybrid trial, not destruction of the Grid or restoration of a supposedly pure past.

openingAndEndingLocks.openingImage: At Junction Square, a smart-town billboard with a blank lettering field physically blocks a traffic lane; deterministic lettering later reads GOING FORWARD TOGETHER.
openingAndEndingLocks.openingFunction: A civic promise and its immediate material contradiction introduce tone, geography and system conflict.
openingAndEndingLocks.finalReport: Golmohar Junction remains noncompliant with several fundamental assumptions.
openingAndEndingLocks.lastAction: Ila frames Director Vale's report on the municipal wall.
openingAndEndingLocks.ilaLastLine: That is how we know the wall is still standing.
openingAndEndingLocks.endingMeaning: The report is both warning and invitation: the system must be altered where its assumptions fail, while residents must make their own judgments reviewable.

ila-dastidar.name: Ila Dastidar
ila-dastidar.stableRole: municipal records officer and practical institutional memory
ila-dastidar.albumOneStart: Protects residents through unofficial reconciliation habits while underestimating how opaque those habits look to outsiders and newer residents.
ila-dastidar.albumOnePressure: Must expose both the Grid's category errors and the human exceptions that have hardened into unreviewable privilege.
ila-dastidar.albumOneEnd: Authors a reviewable exception process and keeps the report as a public instrument, not a private victory.
ila-dastidar.knowledgeRule: She knows records, names, routes and prior municipal promises; she does not automatically understand the Grid's technical internals.

riju-dhar.name: Riju Dhar
riju-dhar.stableRole: young municipal reconciliation clerk and field troubleshooter
riju-dhar.albumOneStart: Believes clean inputs and careful maintenance can reconcile nearly every case.
riju-dhar.albumOnePressure: Sees correct data produce a wrong civic outcome and sees informal intervention reproduce bias.
riju-dhar.albumOneEnd: Helps design the audit trail that records both automated decisions and accountable human overrides.
riju-dhar.knowledgeRule: He can inspect forms, devices and interfaces; he cannot infer private histories or repair infrastructure without local expertise.

ananya-rook.name: Dr Ananya Rook
ananya-rook.stableRole: clinician and repairer at Rook Clinic
ananya-rook.albumOneStart: Maintains a parallel clinical and equipment memory because neither official inventory nor local recollection is sufficient alone.
ananya-rook.albumOnePressure: Triage categories improve supply visibility while misreading urgent edge cases.
ananya-rook.albumOneEnd: Supports a documented clinical override with later audit rather than permanent exemption.
ananya-rook.knowledgeRule: She understands bodies, repairs and clinic constraints; she does not pronounce every civic dispute medically.

babul-courier.name: Babul Courier
babul-courier.stableRole: cycle-van courier and route witness, commonly called Babul-da
babul-courier.albumOneStart: Keeps parcels, forms and news moving through knowledge accumulated in his route.
babul-courier.albumOnePressure: Optimised dispatch improves some deliveries but excludes addresses the database cannot resolve.
babul-courier.albumOneEnd: Accepts route logging that preserves accountable local annotations instead of turning his memory into unquestionable authority.
babul-courier.knowledgeRule: He knows physical routes and recurring delivery patterns; he cannot know all recipients' motives or every administrative rule.

cecil-c17.name: Unit C-17
cecil-c17.stableRole: non-human municipal compliance and measurement unit
cecil-c17.albumOneStart: Executes inspection rules literally and records anomalies with precise language.
cecil-c17.albumOnePressure: Encounters facts that are physically observable but invalid under its categories.
cecil-c17.albumOneEnd: Can report unresolved assumptions and operate within hybrid procedure; it does not become human.
cecil-c17.knowledgeRule: Cecil knows its sensor readings, assigned rules and logged inputs. It does not intuit subtext, affection, sarcasm or unrecorded history.

director-vale.name: Director Vale
director-vale.albumOneStart: Arrives prepared to distinguish resistance from implementation failure and expects the model's categories to hold.
director-vale.albumOnePressure: Observes genuine gains, damaging edge cases and human practices that are both necessary and unaccountable.
director-vale.albumOneEnd: Files the noncompliance report as a diagnosis of assumptions and authorises a constrained hybrid trial.
director-vale.knowledgeRule: Vale has regional comparisons and formal authority; they do not know Golmohar's unrecorded routes and must learn them through evidence.

relationshipContinuity.start: Mutual affection and professional trust complicated by argument over undocumented exceptions.
relationshipContinuity.movement: Each is forced to admit the other's method catches failures their own misses.
relationshipContinuity.end: They co-author the hybrid audit trail without becoming ideologically identical.
relationshipContinuity.never: parent-child simplification, romance, or effortless agreement

relationshipContinuity.start: Guarded institutional peers with unequal authority.
relationshipContinuity.movement: Ila supplies cases; Vale demands comparable evidence; both uncover inconvenient facts.
relationshipContinuity.end: Respectful disagreement produces an official experimental route, not personal surrender.

relationshipContinuity.start: Riju treats Cecil as a maintainable civic device and overestimates shared meanings.
relationshipContinuity.movement: They develop precise operational shorthand through corrections.
relationshipContinuity.end: Riju respects Cecil's limits instead of anthropomorphising them.

relationshipContinuity.start: Trusted colleagues who exchange practical evidence.
relationshipContinuity.movement: They disagree when clinical urgency and municipal precedent pull in different directions.
relationshipContinuity.end: Their override procedure records both reasons and later review.

relationshipContinuity.start: Route expert and form expert each think the other begins from the wrong map.
relationshipContinuity.movement: A delivery crisis proves that physical evidence and consistent identifiers both matter.
relationshipContinuity.end: They create a reversible route annotation instead of canonising memory.

relationshipContinuity.start: Vale treats Cecil as a reliable instrument within scope.
relationshipContinuity.movement: Cecil's precise anomalies reveal scope failure rather than device disobedience.
relationshipContinuity.end: Vale accepts unresolved output without pretending Cecil made a moral judgment.

animalContinuity.appeal-the-goose: Follows food, queues, barriers and familiar bags. It never understands legal procedure and moves only through physically connected routes.
animalContinuity.ghori-the-station-dog: Uses rail vibration and routine, not clock-reading or prediction, and remains within the halt unless transport is shown.
animalContinuity.roll-forty-seven-goat: Moves between School No. 3 and the market route with an established handler; its erroneous record persists until explicitly corrected.
animalContinuity.noticeboard-crow: Moves between Junction Square and the municipal roof, taking loose metal clips rather than politically selecting documents.

demonstratedGains: more consistent stock and queue visibility
faster processing for clean, common cases
better routing when addresses and infrastructure are correctly represented
demonstratedHarms: people, addresses and urgent cases rejected when they do not fit available categories
optimised routes that ignore physical access, informal care and monsoon conditions
false confidence when tidy data hides an invalid assumption
accountability diffused across automated decisions no one locally can explain
pressure to alter reality to satisfy a metric
humanFailures: exceptions remembered by a few people but unavailable to newcomers
favours that bypass a queue without review
pride in improvisation delaying preventive maintenance
hybridTrialRules: Every automated decision exposes the rule and source record used.
A named human may issue a time-limited override with a stated reason.
Overrides enter a shared register and receive a later review date.
Residents can submit physical evidence and oral testimony through an accessible route.
Repeated exceptions trigger model or policy review rather than permanent case-by-case patching.
Human decisions are sampled for favouritism, exclusion and inconsistency.
An emergency route acts immediately but preserves a post-event audit trail.
forbiddenResolution: destroying or switching off the Grid as the complete answer
making a single perfect dataset solve civic judgment
revealing Director Vale as corrupt to avoid the institutional argument
turning Cecil human to make the system compassionate

productionTracking.exceptionPolicy: Any departure from a canonical fact requires a written reason, affected pages, downstream prompt invalidation and named approval. Silent continuity repair is prohibited.
